author: Nintendo of America
description:
The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero releases in fall 2026 on Nintendo Switch 2! 

Welcome back to Crossbell! With improved performance, higher resolution, and upscaled textures, join Lloyd Bannings as he is assigned to Crossbell's Special Support Section. He and his new teammates must prove themselves as they fight to overcome the injustice of a city gripped by corruption. 

#NintendoSwitch2 #TheLegendofHeroes #TrailsfromZero
